response.text: {"verdict":"fix","issues":["GET /v1/tasks returns an unbounded array without pagination, filtering, or limits, posing scalability and performance risks.","Explicit reliance on client-side validation for UUID and ISO 8601 date formats violates security and data integrity best practices.","The POST request body omits required fields from the Task schema (status, created_at, updated_at) without specifying server-side defaults or generation rules, creating a contract ambiguity.","PATCH and DELETE endpoints lack concurrency control mechanisms (e.g., ETags, If-Match headers), risking race conditions and lost updates.","The id path parameter is defined as a generic string without the uuid format constraint used in the Task schema, causing validation inconsistency between routing and payload processing."],"suggestions":["Implement pagination (e.g., limit/offset or cursor-based) for GET /v1/tasks and document the response structure.","Enforce server-side validation for uuid and date-time formats, treating client input as untrusted.","Explicitly define server-side defaults for status (e.g., 'pending') and auto-generation rules for created_at/updated_at in the POST endpoint documentation.","Add ETag and If-Match header requirements to PATCH and DELETE endpoints to support optimistic concurrency control.","Standardize the id parameter definition by applying the uuid format constraint to both path parameters and schema properties."]}
